summary: Boss task: Commander Zilyana is the Saradomin general of the God Wars Dungeon, fought in the Saradomin boss room; the task is assigned only after unlocking Like a Boss and requires 70 Agility, Death Plateau and 40 Saradomin kill count (or an ecumenical key) to enter her chamber.
styleNotes: Attacks with Crush and Magic; poison resistance 100 and venom resistance 100 per the infobox (effectively immune to poison and venom); immunecannon = No but God Wars Dungeon inhabitants destroy cannons.
requiredItems: Rope (x2, first visit to Saradomin's Encampment only; three total if first ever God Wars Dungeon visit)
usefulItems: Saradomin-aligned item and items of the other gods for protection
Climbing boots or Trollheim Teleport (61 Magic, Eadgar's Ruse)

summary: Zombies are a low-level task (10 Combat) from Turael, Spria, Mazchna and Krystilia that most players finish as fast as possible because ordinary zombies have a very poor drop table. Undead cows and chickens at Alice's farm west of the Ectofuntus are the quickest kills, while Undead Druids in Forthos Dungeon or Vorkath are the profitable alternatives for players with the requirements. On a Krystilia Wilderness task, zombie pirates at the Chaos Temple are lucrative if the Medium Wilderness Diary is done; otherwise the Graveyard of Shadows and eastern Ruins are the Wilderness options. Zombies have a 50 percent elemental weakness to fire spells and use melee.
styleNotes: Zombies are undead (Salve amulet works, including on Vorkath), have a 50 percent elemental weakness to fire spells, are not poisonous, and are not cannon-immune; the Magic Guild dungeon zombies cannot be killed with melee.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon at Graveyard of Shadows or Alice's farm
Teleport anchoring scroll (Chaos Temple, against elder chaos druid teleports)
Amulet of avarice (notes zombie pirate drops)

summary: TzKal-Zuk is the final monster of the Inferno in Mor Ul Rek and can be chosen in place of a TzHaar slayer task after unlocking Hot Stuff, provided the player has already defeated Zuk once off-task; the Inferno requires a one-time fire cape payment to TzHaar-Ket-Keh.
styleNotes: Attacks with Typeless Magic and Typeless Ranged; poison resistance 100 and venom resistance 100 per the infobox (effectively immune to poison and venom) and immune to strong burns.
requiredItems: Fire cape (one-time payment to TzHaar-Ket-Keh to access the Inferno)
